entities.name: Juan Bautista Pérez

entities.summary: Juan Bautista Pérez, was a Venezuelan lawyer, magistrate, and politician who served as the president of Venezuela between 1929 until 1931. He was a puppet president, as Juan Vicente Gómez was the de facto ruler of Venezuela during Pérez's presidency.
